pages.title: A late bus · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy Monday morning in Philadelphia. Pedro stands at a bus stop with his bag. He looks at his watch again and again. The bus is not here yet. An older woman sits on the bench with a book. He decides to ask her a question.
“Excuse me, is this the stop for the number twelve?” says Pedro. “Yes, it is. But the bus is late today.” says Ann. “How late is it?” says Pedro.
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: A late bus · 3/3
paragraphs: “It is two dollars and fifty cents, exact change.” says Ann. “Oh, I have coins. Here comes the bus!” says Pedro. The bus arrives with a loud sound and opens its doors. Pedro puts coins in the box and finds a seat. Ann sits near him and says hello. At the fifth stop, she points at the window. Pedro gets off at Market Street and waves. A small question can save a morning.
